**What we’re building**  
A single‑page booking app that lets people log in with email, pick a time slot, and confirm a booking.  
The user sees only their own bookings, can cancel inside a 24 h window, and an admin panel is reserved for you.  
It’s an **Amber**‑level app because it handles personal data (names, emails, times) and requires logins.

---

### One‑screen plan (for approval)

```
What we are building: A simple booking site – users sign in (magic link only), select a
time slot from a calendar, confirm, and later cancel if needed.
Who uses it: The public (anyone with an email). Risk level: Amber – logins, personal data.
Day‑one features: 1️⃣ Email‑only login (magic link). 2️⃣ View available slots. 3️⃣ Create / cancel booking.
Information it stores: Bookings table (user_id, slot_id, status, created_at). Private – only logged‑in user can see or delete their rows. “Is there money involved?” – no payments in v1.
Logins: Supabase Auth (magic link). Money: none (AI or paid services not used yet). Rough monthly cost: < $10 (Supabase free tier + tiny Stripe if you later add paid slots).
Built with: Next.js 13 (app router) + Supabase (Auth, Postgres, Storage). This stack gives instant auth, a zero‑config database, and a fast dev experience.
Steps: 1. Initialise Next.js + Supabase. 2. Add auth pages. 3. Create bookings table + RLS policies. 4. Build calendar UI. 5. Wire create / cancel logic. 6. Add admin page. 7. Safety checks and save point before each.
Safety: secrets on the server only, user‑specific data, two‑step cancel, save point before each change, RLS enabled. Not in v1: AI, payments, multi‑currency, bulk uploads, external APIs.
```
